subject: Grant queue cutoffs & exec approval cadence for upcoming 409A window
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Grant batch and 409A window week of Sep 21 - cutoff dates

Team —

FYI: our external valuation provider confirmed the next 409A valuation window is the week of Sep 21 (final report expected by Sep 24). To get option grants included under that valuation (so strike prices match the new 409A), operations needs final grant paperwork and payroll input by EOD Sep 17. I attached a tentative grant batch (grant_batch_Q3.xlsx) and the calendar (409a-window-calendar.pdf).

What I need from you:
- A list of hires/offers that must be included in this batch (name, role, planned start date).
- Exec approval memos for any awards > 0.25% or special vesting structures.
- Confirmation of headcount freeze windows (Tessa) so we don't inadvertently reserve slots that violate approvals.

There are three live offers I highlighted that are time-sensitive (rows in the spreadsheet). If we miss Sep 17, the next inclusion will be mid-October and will push start-date communications for those candidates.

Thanks — please mark your availability for a quick sync if needed.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Total Rewards | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Attachments: grant_batch_Q3.xlsx, 409a-window-calendar.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Grant batch and 409A window week of Sep 21 - cutoff dates

Thanks Laura — good to know. Proposed plan:
- Cutoff for grant paperwork: Sep 17 EOD (ops will run validation on Sep 18).
- Exec approval slot: Sep 15 morning (30-minute window) to review any >0.25% awards or manager exceptions. I drafted a short memo for approvers (attached exec-approval-memo.docx).
- Tessa: can you confirm the headcount freeze goes into effect Sep 14 at 23:59 PT, with the usual exception process for critical business hires?

Markus, please flag any offers where comp band pushes the grant % above standard band so Laura can prepare the memo.

If we want to accelerate a single grant for a candidate who is asking for an earlier start, we can route it as a one-off (pre-approval + counsel sign-off) but that will need to be explicit.

I will loop in our recruiter contact (Kate) after we firm the list so candidates get aligned communications.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Americas | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Attachment: exec-approval-memo.docx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Grant batch and 409A window week of Sep 21 - cutoff dates

On Fri, Sep 11, 2026 at 9:08 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposed plan...

Confirmed: headcount freeze starts Sep 14 23:59 PT. Exceptions will be considered if hiring manager provides business case + hiring scorecard; route exceptions to me + Markus for expedited review.

One note: we have a candidate in AE II (Recruiter: Kate Barnes) whose notice period ends Sep 22 and they are asking for an offer now with the ability to sign and start Sep 28. That hire is within comp bands but requested a 0.35% grant (band is typically 0.25%). If we need that grant to clear the market, I recommend pre-approving via exec slot on Sep 15 and tagging it as a one-off with counsel sign-off.

If everyone agrees to the Sep 15 exec slot, I will reserve 09:00–09:30 PT on the calendar.

Tessa Morgan
VP, People Operations | Redwood Inference
Tessa_Morgan@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Barnes <kate@talentbridge.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Emily Greenwood <emily@greenwood-law.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final: timing for AE II offer (grant timing and communications)

Kate — copying internal team to confirm timing for the AE II candidate you represent.

Short version for candidate comms:
- We will issue a formal offer this week with standard comp and the proposed equity (0.35% requested). The equity will be processed under the upcoming 409A valuation if the exec committee signs off on Sep 15. Payroll needs all final paperwork by Sep 17 EOD to include this grant in the Sep 21 valuation batch.
- If exec approval is delayed, the fallback is inclusion in the October batch (later strike price). We will state that final grant date is pending exec approval and 409A scheduling.

Laura / Emily: please advise if you foresee any counsel steps that would prevent us from closing if exec approval is provided on Sep 15 (Emily, happy to get a quick read).

Kate: please hold candidate communications until Sep 15 afternoon (we should have final confirmation by then). If candidate pushes for an earlier sign date, we can discuss an interim offer note but will not finalize grant terms until approvals/counsel sign-off are complete.

Thanks all — see calendar invite for Sep 15 09:00 PT.

Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Americas | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Attachments referenced: grant_batch_Q3.xlsx, exec-approval-memo.docx
